video_title: 把邮件、表格和日报交给 AI，工作会变成什么样？
audience: Chinese-speaking knowledge workers curious about practical AI automation
visual_hook: A fictional illustration of a human leaving on time while an AI assistant finishes routine tasks; not a measured productivity claim
